source: sars-guide:PAYE-GEN-01-G21 Rev 1 p. 15 ("Employers must apply the percentage of employees' tax as indicated on the directive prior to considering allowable deductions") and p. 17 (IRP3(b): remuneration constituting commission)
notes: R30 000 a month to a commission earner with an IRP3(b) fixed-percentage directive of 20%. The guide gives the rule, not these figures. PAYE = 20% x 30 000 = 6 000.00 (the tables would give 4 681.00). UIF 177.12, SDL 300.00. Net 30 000 - 6 000 - 177.12. The calculator has no fixed-rate directive input (only a lump-sum directive's PAYE), so input.unmodelled carries it.
